_about: The second sight's item (docs/notes/second-sights.md): srp_second_sight, dict id 2676 (weapon-kit's SECOND_SIGHT_ITEM), never sold (category 22, base_cost 0, no gun takes it as a module). A weapon's second sight is an optic's own item in kit slot 6; the client's weapon kit (patch 68) gives the item config cook this item's record in its place, its value the optic's dict id (low half) and its side (high half, 0 left, 1 right). Its modification 996676 adds data/srp_second_sight and data/srp_second_side to the weapon from the record's two halves, as a decal's sets its place; patch 161 reads them. Made from the DeltaPoint Pro's config as scope-modules-1 leaves it; its data (zoom, models) is not read.
